notes: Independent statutory regulators and oversight bodies (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA, IFSCA, IBBI, TRAI, CCI, CERC, PNGRB, AERA, NHRC, NCW, NCPCR, NCM, CVC, CIC, Lokpal, Press Council of India, NABARD, SIDBI, EXIM Bank, NHB, NPCI). Known gaps/doubts: (1) RBI Central Board of Directors (part-time/independent directors) not enumerated — only Governor, 4 Deputy Governors and the Monetary Policy Committee are covered; (2) exact appointment dates could not be confirmed for several holders (IRDAI, PFRDA, TRAI, PNGRB, NHRC chairs; most Whole-Time/Members across SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA, TRAI, PNGRB, NABARD, SIDBI, EXIM Bank, NHB) — identity is high/medium confidence from primary sources but the exact 'since' date is marked null or approximate (year/month only) rather than invented; (3) CVC's and Lokpal's own websites (cvc.gov.in, lokpal.gov.in) are client-rendered SPAs that returned no leadership content to automated fetch — those two bodies' holder data rests on Wikipedia only and is marked confidence:medium pending a primary-source cross-check; (4) NHRC currently has only a Chairperson recorded — sitting Members were not confirmed in this pass; (5) indiacode.nic.in legal-source links were not resolved for any Act (legalBasis text given instead; officialUrl given for every body); (6) NPCI is not a Government of India body — it is a Section-8 nonprofit promoted by RBI/IBA and owned by member banks; included per the segment's ownership brief as a quasi-regulatory payments body under RBI oversight, kind classification (autonomous_body) is a judgement call, not a legal category; (7) PNGRB Chairperson's appointment date and PNGRB Members' identities are only medium/low confidence (PNGRB's own site would not serve a members/board page to curl; corroborated Chairperson via the site's own homepage press item and Wikipedia only).

entities.name: Reserve Bank of India
entities.description: India's central bank; regulates banks, NBFCs and payment systems, conducts monetary policy, manages the currency and India's foreign-exchange reserves.

entities.name: Monetary Policy Committee
entities.description: Six-member statutory committee that sets India's benchmark policy interest rate to meet the inflation target set by the Government.
entities.legalBasis: Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, Chapter III-F (s.45ZB), inserted by the Finance Act, 2016

entities.name: Securities and Exchange Board of India
entities.description: Regulates India's securities and capital markets, registers and supervises stock exchanges, brokers, mutual funds and listed companies, and protects investors.
entities.legalBasis: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992

entities.name: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
entities.description: Regulates and promotes the insurance and reinsurance industry in India, licenses insurers and intermediaries and protects policyholders' interests.
entities.legalBasis: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999

entities.name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
entities.description: Regulates and develops India's pension sector, including the National Pension System (NPS) and Atal Pension Yojana, and registers pension fund managers and intermediaries.
entities.legalBasis: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 2013

entities.name: International Financial Services Centres Authority
entities.description: Unified regulator for banking, capital markets, insurance and funds management in India's International Financial Services Centres, currently GIFT City, Gandhinagar.
entities.legalBasis: International Financial Services Centres Authority Act, 2019

entities.name: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India
entities.description: Regulates insolvency professionals, insolvency professional agencies and information utilities, and oversees the corporate and individual insolvency resolution processes under the IBC.

entities.name: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India
entities.description: Regulates telecom services and tariffs and advises the Government on telecom and broadcasting policy, licensing and interconnection matters.
entities.legalBasis: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997

entities.name: Competition Commission of India
entities.description: Enforces the Competition Act by preventing anti-competitive agreements and abuse of dominance and regulating mergers and acquisitions (combinations).

entities.name: Central Electricity Regulatory Commission
entities.description: Regulates tariffs of central generating stations and inter-state transmission, and issues licences for inter-state transmission and trading of electricity.

entities.name: Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board
entities.description: Regulates refining, processing, storage, transport, distribution, marketing and sale of petroleum, petroleum products and natural gas, and authorises city gas distribution and pipeline networks.
entities.legalBasis: Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board Act, 2006

entities.name: Airports Economic Regulatory Authority of India
entities.description: Regulates aeronautical tariffs and monitors performance standards at major Indian airports.
entities.legalBasis: Airports Economic Regulatory Authority of India Act, 2008

entities.name: National Human Rights Commission
entities.description: Investigates and inquires into complaints of human-rights violations, reviews laws and safeguards, and recommends remedial action to the Government.

entities.name: National Commission for Women
entities.description: Statutory body that reviews the constitutional and legal safeguards for women, recommends remedial legislation, and facilitates redressal of grievances relating to women's rights.

entities.name: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
entities.description: Examines and reviews laws and mechanisms for protecting children's rights, inquires into violations (including under POCSO and the Juvenile Justice Act), and recommends remedial measures.
entities.legalBasis: Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005

entities.name: National Commission for Minorities
entities.description: Evaluates the progress of the development of notified religious minorities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis, Jains) and safeguards their rights.

entities.name: Central Vigilance Commission
entities.description: Apex integrity institution that oversees vigilance administration in central government bodies, advises on corruption cases and superintends the CBI's anti-corruption work.

entities.name: Central Information Commission
entities.description: Adjudicates second appeals and complaints under the Right to Information Act against central public authorities and can penalise Public Information Officers for non-compliance.

entities.name: Lokpal of India
entities.description: Anti-corruption ombudsman with jurisdiction to inquire into corruption allegations against the Prime Minister (with safeguards), Union Ministers, MPs and central government officials.

entities.name: Press Council of India
entities.description: Quasi-judicial body that preserves the freedom of the press and maintains standards of newspapers and news agencies in India, adjudicating complaints of journalistic misconduct.

entities.name: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
entities.description: Apex development finance institution for agriculture and rural development; refinances rural credit institutions, supervises cooperative banks and RRBs, and promotes rural infrastructure via the RIDF.
entities.legalBasis: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development Act, 1981

entities.name: Small Industries Development Bank of India
entities.description: Principal financial institution for promotion, financing and development of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) sector; coordinates the functions of institutions in MSME financing.
entities.legalBasis: Small Industries Development Bank of India Act, 1989

entities.name: Export-Import Bank of India
entities.description: India's export credit agency; provides financial assistance to exporters and importers and functions as the principal financial institution for coordinating export credit institutions.

entities.name: National Housing Bank
entities.description: Apex regulator and refinancing institution for housing finance companies in India, promoting a sound and healthy housing finance system.

entities.name: National Payments Corporation of India
entities.description: Not-for-profit umbrella organisation for retail payments and settlement systems in India (UPI, IMPS, RuPay, FASTag, AePS); promoted by RBI and the Indian Banks' Association and owned by member banks, operating under RBI oversight.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act, 2013, s.8 (incorporation); regulated as a payment system operator under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007

relations.basis: RBI Act 1934 s.45ZB(2)(a) — Governor chairs the MPC ex officio, with a casting vote
RBI is administratively attached to the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
RBI Act 1934 s.8 — Governor and Deputy Governors appointed by the Central Government
Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 — RBI regulates and supervises NPCI as an authorised retail payment system operator; NPCI was promoted by RBI together with the Indian Banks' Association
RBI Deputy Governor sits ex officio on the NABARD Board and RBI holds a minority equity stake
SEBI is administratively attached to the Department of Economic Affairs (Capital Markets Division), Ministry of Finance
SEBI Act 1992 s.5 — Chairman and Whole Time Members appointed by the Central Government
IRDAI is administratively attached to the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
IRDAI Act 1999 s.4 — Chairperson and Members appointed by the Central Government
PFRDA is administratively attached to the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
PFRDA Act 2013 s.4 — Chairperson and Whole-time Members appointed by the Central Government
IFSCA is administratively attached to the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
IFSCA Act 2019 s.4 — Chairperson appointed by the Central Government
IBBI is administratively attached to the Ministry of Corporate Affairs
Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016 s.189 — Chairperson appointed by the Central Government
TRAI is administratively attached to the Department of Telecommunications, Ministry of Communications
TRAI Act 1997 s.4 — Chairperson and Members appointed by the Central Government
CCI is administratively attached to the Ministry of Corporate Affairs
Competition Act 2002 s.9 — Chairperson and Members appointed by the Central Government
CERC is administratively attached to the Ministry of Power
Electricity Act 2003 s.85 — Chairperson and Members appointed by the Central Government on recommendation of a Selection Committee
PNGRB is administratively attached to the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
PNGRB Act 2006 s.5 — Chairperson and Members appointed by the Central Government
AERA is administratively attached to the Ministry of Civil Aviation
AERA Act 2008 s.5 — Chairperson and Members appointed by the Central Government
NHRC's secretariat receives administrative/budgetary support via the Ministry of Home Affairs, though the Commission is functionally independent

Protection of Human Rights Act 1993 s.4 — appointed by the President on recommendation of a Selection Committee (PM, Speaker Lok Sabha, Home Minister, Leaders of Opposition in LS & RS, Deputy Chairman RS)
NCW is administratively attached to the Ministry of Women and Child Development
National Commission for Women Act 1990 s.3 — Chairperson nominated by the Central Government
NCPCR is administratively attached to the Ministry of Women and Child Development
Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act 2005 s.3 — Chairperson nominated by the Central Government
NCM is administratively attached to the Ministry of Minority Affairs
National Commission for Minorities Act 1992 s.3 — Chairperson nominated by the Central Government
CVC's secretariat is serviced via the Department of Personnel and Training for administrative purposes
CVC Act 2003 s.4 — appointed by the President on recommendation of a committee (PM, Home Minister, Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha)
CIC is administratively attached to the Department of Personnel and Training
RTI Act 2005 s.12 — appointed by the President on recommendation of a committee (PM, Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the PM)
Lokpal's secretariat/administrative matters are handled via the Department of Personnel and Training

Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act 2013 s.4 — appointed by the President on recommendation of a Selection Committee (PM, Speaker Lok Sabha, Leader of Opposition Lok Sabha, Chief Justice of India or nominee judge, an eminent jurist)
Press Council of India is administratively attached to the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting

Press Council Act 1978 s.5 — Chairman nominated jointly by a committee of the Chairman of the Council of States, the Speaker of the House of the People and a person elected by the Council members; formal notification issued by the Central Government
NABARD is administratively attached to the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, which holds the bulk of GoI's equity
NABARD Act 1981 s.6(1)(a) — Chairman appointed by the Central Government
NABARD Act 1981 s.6(1)(c) — a Deputy Governor of RBI is a Director on the NABARD Board ex officio
SIDBI is administratively attached to the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
SIDBI Act 1989 s.6 — Chairman and Managing Director appointed by the Central Government
EXIM Bank is wholly owned by the Government of India and administratively attached to the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
Export-Import Bank of India Act 1981 s.7 — Managing Director appointed by the Central Government
NHB is wholly owned by the Government of India (since RBI divested its stake in 2019) and administratively attached to the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
National Housing Bank Act 1987 — Managing Director appointed by the Central Government
